# Medium healing mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadHealthMedium | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Medium healing x1 | Duration: 10s | Cooldown: 2m | Health Regen: +75 HP over 10s

# Introduction

Medium healing mead is a Swamp-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Medium healing.

## Recipe

Mead base: Medium healing is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 4 Bloodbag
• 10 Raspberries
• 1 Dandelion
Six Medium healing meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Upon consumption, it restores 75 health over 10 seconds.
A 2-min cooldown is applied preventing consumption of another healing mead.

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
